candidate_program.name: global_residual_pressure
candidate_program.rationale: Approximates retained packing reward from residual edge count and pair-weight pressure, normalizing count and reward scales separately. Global residual edge enumeration may be quadratic, and aggregate pressure can miss arrangement-dependent effects.
candidate_program.rule: weight + compatible_weight / (1 + residual_edge_count / max(1, remaining_count - degree - 1) + residual_edge_product / (1 + compatible_weight * compatible_weight / max(1, remaining_count - degree - 1)))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
